content: Man needs difficulties in life because they are necessary to enjoy success.
author: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
explanation: Effortless accomplishments lack flavor and character-building power. The obstacles we struggle against are the precise training grounds that give true accomplishment its richness.
practicalInsight: Reframe your biggest current workplace or life obstacle as an intentional strength-training exercise designed to expand your capacity.
reflectionPrompt: How is my current hardship secretly forging the resilience I will need for greater responsibilities?
